items.title: Higher direct images of a torsion sheaf, and of a complex with torsion cohomology, along a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism are torsion
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records that torsion is preserved by higher direct images along a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism, for a single torsion sheaf and for a bounded below complex with torsion cohomology sheaves (statement lines 13923-13934). The proof (proof lines 13936-13955) uses the presheaf description of the higher direct images on affine V, where the fibre product is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and invokes the torsion statement for that case. H2: one uniform computation applied twice, written out.
